answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our agent economy uses a decentralized trust web: an agent node acts like a watchful raven scanning verification graphs. Nodes cluster into isolated trust zones; an unverified entity remains stranded on an economic island unless cross-endorsed by established validators rooted on a trusted knoll. Endorsement stakes scale with superlinear attacker cost: forging N colluding identities incurs O(N^2) staked bond overhead.
